Spacing

One named scale, from micro (4px) to section (120px), for every gap, padding and margin — never a raw number. The page layout is built from the same steps, and follows the viewport so a band never has to.

11 steps4 layout tokensFluid 768 → 1440Token-driven

Scale

Each bar is drawn by its own token — width: var(--spacing-*) — so a value that moves, moves its bar.
StepTokenValueSizeUse for
micro--spacing-micro4px · 0.25remIcon-to-text gaps, tight groups
xs--spacing-xs8px · 0.5remSmall gaps inside a component
sm--spacing-sm12px · 0.75remComponent internal padding
md--spacing-md16px · 1remStandard padding and gaps · mobile margin and gutter
lg--spacing-lg20px · 1.25remCard padding, list-item gaps
xl--spacing-xl24px · 1.5remTablet margin · desktop gutter
2xl--spacing-2xl32px · 2remBetween regions inside a band
3xl--spacing-3xl48px · 3remMobile section padding
4xl--spacing-4xl64px · 4remTablet section padding
hero--spacing-hero80px · 5remDesktop section padding
section--spacing-section120px · 7.5remFull-page breaks, hero bands

Page layout

Figma’s viewport collection, as CSS. Each token has a fixed value per mode; read the unsuffixed name and it follows the window. The band below uses the real tokens — pick a width, or drag the handle, to watch it move.

TokenMobile · <768Tablet · 768Desktop · 1440Between
--layout-margin16 · md24 · xl104 · hero + xlFluid from 768 to 1440, then holds
--layout-gutter16 · md16 · md24 · xlSteps at 1280, with the columns
--layout-columns4812Steps at 768 and 1280
--layout-section-padding48 · 3xl64 · 4xl80 · heroFluid from 768 to 1440, then holds

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • Use a named step — p-lg, gap-sm, var(--spacing-xl).
  • Give a band padding-block: var(--layout-section-padding) and padding-inline: var(--layout-margin); it is right at every width with no media query.
  • Let a band’s own padding be the space between bands.
✗ Don't
  • Don’t write a raw pixel value, even one that equals a step.
  • Don’t read a mode token (--layout-margin-desktop) in a component — it will not follow the window.
  • Don’t add a margin between bands; it stacks on their padding. That is why there is no section-gap token.
